text: The megawatt-years on this page are gross of cause: the register never prints why a date moved, and investigation 006, over the 213 slips of 24 months or more among the 863 project-stages it could join to the Transmission Works Register, classed 60% as project-led, 26% as works-led (a same-direction move in an enabling scheme's proxy date inside the window) and 14% as unattributable (investigations/006-connection-slippage-attribution/RESULTS.md and evidence/twr-attribution-summary.json); no figure on this page changes.

text: The archive now holds 83 copies of the register dated 25 Jul 2025 to 15 May 2026 (NESO's EIR response FOI/26/216, journalled 15 Oct 2026; investigations/005-connection-date-credibility/ACQUISITION-FOI-26-216.md), so the 301-day hole named under Gaps is closed in the archive, with no gap over 7 days inside it. This series was computed on 23 Sep 2026, before they arrived, and is not recomputed under version 4: its rows carry version 2's closed rows byte for byte, and the four reformed-regime rows would restate (AMENDMENTS.md, 2026-10-15). A version 5 beside this one is what would recompute. No figure on this page changes.
